📺 ● LIVE — THE FEAST. the whole village are on television.
📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: And we are LIVE with a special presentation: THE FEAST! The little ones are putting flavored matter in their mouths ON PURPOSE. For joy. The file says joy.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Heinrich opens the pantry wide: 9× Foraged food, 13× Blackberry, 1× Foraged food. Tomas, Aldi, Ruth eat until the fire burns low. The laughter stays low — somebody's seat is empty, and everybody sees it. For one evening, grief sits at the fire with them instead of standing over them. (−2,802 kcal from the pantry) Nathan stayed in their tent, feverish; Henry stayed in their tent, feverish; Ella stayed in their tent, feverish. The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed.
🍖 FEASTED ×4.05 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×3). Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Nostalgia is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
FEASTED ×4.05: the feast was the weapon.
FEASTED ×4.05: Ella's blow carries the feast.

📺 The Iron Pantry. An alien vault-lock on a full pantry. Five tumblers, one hour of air. Pick it and the village eats. Jam it and the cameras watch you starve politely.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A vault door the size of weather. Behind a glass panel: a full pantry — grain, smoked meat, winter itself, stacked and lit like a museum.

Five tumblers. One hour of air in the anteroom. The System, almost gentle: "PICK IT. EAT. THE CAMERAS LOVE HUNGER."

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.

📺 The Witness. Three witnesses describe last night's attack on the trap-line. Two are true memories. One the System wrote. Name the fabrication — the village arms for whatever you name.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

Last night something hit the far trap-line. Three witnesses, seated in a row under the lights.

The System, mild: "TWO ARE TRUE MEMORIES. ONE WE WROTE. NAME THE FABRICATION — THE VILLAGE ARMS FOR WHATEVER YOU NAME."
